verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a Document Segmentation capability that splits multi-document PDFs into logical sections using a schema and returns page ranges per segment. Pipelines can chain segment with extract, and checkpoints let /segment and /extract reuse one parse, so a single upload can feed several steps. However, the docs do not show that segments are explicitly classified by document type, or that per-document extraction results come back automatically from one call. Missing for 10: explicit document-type classification per segment, documented automatic per-segment extraction output from a single upload, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, multi-document packets are classified and split automatically — one upload, per-document results

citations.quote: Split multi-document PDFs into separate logical sections
Segment a document into sections using a schema. Returns page ranges for each identified segment.
Pipelines chain processors (convert, extract, segment, custom) into reusable, versioned configurations.
Use save_checkpoint=true to save parsed state for later /extract or /segment calls.
